Lena (Support): Escalation T-11090: trial tenant NimbusAI seeing intermittent embed 504s after SSO enabled. They're in the middle of a proof run; renewal conversation in 9 days. Error spike started ~90m ago.
Omar (CS): Thanks Lena. Short impact summary + contact? CS needs a 1-2 sentence customer note and an internal 3-step comms plan.
Lena (Support): Impact: embed success ~25% over last 2hrs (was ~99%). Logs: "POST /v1/embeds -> 504 gateway timeout -> kvcache fallback thrash". Attempts: restarted pool, bumped timeouts, no change. Contact: Maya Lin (maya@nimbusai.com), PST.
Vik (Solutions): Quick mitigation idea: route tenant to a small dedicated burst pool and pin to an older embed model (rwd-embed-3b-legacy) to reduce memory churn. Also enable tenant-specific prefix caching. Sample route patch I can apply once Ops confirms.
Rita (Ops): I can provision a 2hr burst (1xA10G). Need approval to consume reserved units. If approved I'll attach and run a smoke test and post the curl to validate.
Omar (CS): Lena, draft the customer note here (1-2 lines + ETA). Also flag whether we should proactively offer a trial credit. I'll coordinate outreach after Ops confirms.
Lena (Support): Draft: "Hi Maya 539 539 "; sorry see raw text? Let's write: "Hi Maya 389 - we're seeing intermittent timeouts from our embeddings API following your SSO change. We're prioritizing a mitigation (route to dedicated pool) and expect an update within 90 minutes. We'll follow up with a short RCA and offer a test window. Apologies for the disruption."
Omar (CS): Tweak: add cc cs@redwood.com and offer a 10% trial credit for impacted runs. I'll send once Rita confirms pool is up.
inc-bot: Incident bridge created -> https://zoom.redwood/bridge/BRG-11090 (auto). Use this for the 16:00 sync.
Rita (Ops): Provisioning burst-nimbus-1 now, ETA ~10m. Smoke test to run from support console (I'll post command).
Rita (Ops): burst-nimbus-1 provisioned. Smoke: 20/20 success, median latency 140ms.
Lena (Support): Verified from support console: success 100% on repeated calls. Sending Omar the draft to go out. Captured request IDs for RCA.
Omar (CS): Outreach sent to Maya (cc cs@redwood.com). Internal comms plan posted: 1) notify AE and renewal owner, 2) run customer validation on bridge at 16:00 PST, 3) open RCA and assign Eng owner within 48h. Marking Priority: High.
Vik (Solutions): Recommend adding a follow-up engineering task: auto-model-pin for trials and telemetry alert when embed error rate >20% for 30m. I'll file a ticket.
Omar (CS): Good. After the bridge, paste any direct customer feedback here so CS can update the renewal assessment. Thanks team.
